memberdef.name: DWARFDataExtractor

briefdescription.para: Extracts the DWARF "initial length" field, which can either be a 32-bit value smaller than 0xfffffff0, or the value 0xffffffff followed by a 64-bit length.

detaileddescription.para: Returns the actual length, and the DWARF format which is encoded in the field. In case of errors, it returns {0, DWARF32} and leaves the offset unchanged.

briefdescription.para: Extracts a value and applies a relocation to the result if one exists for the given offset.
Extracts an address-sized value and applies a relocation to the result if one exists for the given offset.
Extracts a DWARF-encoded pointer in Offset using Encoding.

detaileddescription.para: There is a DWARF encoding that uses a PC-relative adjustment. For these values, AbsPosOffset is used to fix them, which should reflect the absolute address of this pointer.

briefdescription.para: A DataExtractor (typically for an in-memory copy of an object-file section) plus a relocation map for that section, if there is one.
